c74object.name: touch.numticker
c74object.digest: High-Precision Numeric Touch and Mouse Controller
c74object.description: An interactive numerical display and precision controller canvas for Max. Features vertical digit dragging, directional tap and hold-repeat stepping, specialized labeling abbreviation engines, a 50/50 Attrui inspector, dual touch sub-interfaces (multi-column sliders and numeric keypad), and Theme Master wireless synchronization.

inlet.digest: Value input, bang, or configuration messages
inlet.description: Accepts numbers to set the value directly, bang to trigger output, or configuration/theme messages to update attributes.

outlet.description: Outputs the current floating-point value whenever it is modified via clicks, drags, hold stepping, or inbound messages.

method.name: bang
method.description: Outputs the current clamped numeric value through the outlet.

method.name: float
method.description: Sets the numerical value, clamps it within integer and decimal digit limits, redraws the display, and outputs the result.

method.name: int
method.description: Converted to float, clamped, redrawn, and output.

method.name: set
method.description: Updates the internal value, clamps it, and redraws the canvas without firing an outlet message.

method.name: update
method.digest: Refresh theme from bus or persistent store
method.description: Forces the component to reload and re-render its visual styling from the global wireless theme bus or persistent dictionary store. Also accepts aliases theme_update and refresh_theme.

attribute.name: mode
attribute.description:
Selects operational interaction mode:
0 = Mouse (directional split tap, continuous hold-stepping, vertical digit dragging)
1 = Touch (launches dedicated floating touch interface on canvas tap)

attribute.name: touch_type
attribute.description:
Selects the layout of the touch window:
0 = Sliders (individual vertical digit column touch faders)
1 = Pad (full scientific numeric keypad with sign toggle, backspace, and clear)

attribute.name: step_size
attribute.description: The amount added or subtracted per directional tap or hold step interval.

attribute.name: hold_speed
attribute.description: Repeat interval in milliseconds when holding down the mouse button in Mouse mode (minimum: 5 ms).

attribute.name: integer_digits
attribute.description: Number of integer digit positions rendered and clamped (clamped 1 to 12).

attribute.name: decimal_digits
attribute.description: Number of fractional decimal places rendered and clamped (clamped 0 to 8).

attribute.name: leading_zeros
attribute.description: Pads the integer portion with zeros up to the integer digit count when enabled.

attribute.name: allow_popup
attribute.description: Shows or hides the top-right launcher dot and enables right-click access to the floating parameter inspector.

attribute.name: name_tag_on
attribute.description: Enables rendering of the integrated name tag tab protruding from or integrated with the ticker frame.

attribute.name: name_tag_text
attribute.description: Raw label text displayed inside the name tag.

attribute.name: tag_position
attribute.description:
Placement of the name tag relative to the ticker numbers:
0 = Top tab
1 = Bottom tab
2 = Left inline prefix
3 = Right inline suffix

attribute.name: case_mode
attribute.description:
Text capitalization normalization:
0 = First Cap (Title Case)
1 = All Cap (Uppercase)
2 = All Small (Lowercase)

attribute.name: label_mode
attribute.description:
Controls abbreviation algorithms on the tag text:
0 = Full (full string rendered)
1 = No Vowels (strips inner vowels while preserving first letters)
2 = Caps Only (extracts capital letters and digits; falls back to initials)
3 = First Letter (extracts the initial of each word)
4 = No Text (suppresses tag text completely)

attribute.name: name_tag_x
attribute.description: Horizontal fine-tuning offset in pixels for the name tag.

attribute.name: name_tag_y
attribute.description: Vertical fine-tuning offset in pixels for the name tag.

attribute.name: name_tag_text_size
attribute.description: Font size in points dedicated to the name tag text.

attribute.name: border_radius
attribute.description: Corner rounding radius of the ticker body and reticle corner brackets.

attribute.name: border_thickness
attribute.description: Stroke line width of the outer border brackets.

attribute.name: border_extension
attribute.description: Length in pixels of the straight tick arms extending from each reticle corner arc.

attribute.name: font
attribute.description: Name of the font family used for numerical digits and tag typography.

attribute.name: text_size
attribute.description: Base point size of the rendered numerical digits (clamped $\ge 6$).

attribute.name: mode_color
attribute.description: RGBA color dedicated to the name tag text and accent features.

attribute.name: background_color
attribute.description: RGBA fill color for the inner ticker body.

attribute.name: border_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the reticle corner brackets and center click dividers.

attribute.name: textcolor
attribute.description: RGBA color for the integer digits, negative sign, and decimal point separator.

attribute.name: popup_dot_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the top-right launcher dot used to open the parameter inspector.

attribute.name: decimal_color
attribute.description: RGBA color dedicated to the fractional decimal digits, visually distinguishing fractions from integers.

attribute.name: highlight_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the active column underline indicator during dragging and mouse scrolling.

attribute.name: pop_bgcolor
attribute.description: RGBA background color of the floating parameter inspector window.

attribute.name: attr_bg_color
attribute.description: RGBA background fill color for individual 50/50 attribute rows.

attribute.name: attr_border_color
attribute.description: RGBA outline color for attribute row containers and value boxes.

attribute.name: attr_slider_color
attribute.description: RGBA active fill color for sliders inside the 50/50 attribute inspector.

attribute.name: attr_text_color
attribute.description: RGBA text color for attribute names and value labels inside the inspector.

attribute.name: show_settings_attrs
attribute.description: Master toggle to show or hide the 50/50 attribute list inside the pop-up inspector window.

attribute.name: mask_performance
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the Value, Mode, Touch UI style, Step Size, and Hold Speed section in the pop-up inspector.

attribute.name: mask_labels
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the Tag Visibility, Position, and Prefix Label/Case Styling section in the pop-up inspector.

attribute.name: mask_geometry
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the Digits, Leading Zeros, Font Size, Radius, Thickness, and Extension section in the pop-up inspector.

attribute.name: mask_colors
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the Ticker Body, Border, Text, Decimal, Highlight, and Dot Colors section in the pop-up inspector.

attribute.name: mask_popup_colors
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the 5-color Inspector Theme Palette section in the pop-up inspector.
